chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever is born upon the fitrah and is known for righteousness in himself, his testimony is valid.

key_terms.الصَّلَاحِ: uprightness and righteousness in one's conduct and state
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: the natural God-given disposition upon which a person is born
key_terms.شَهَادَتُهُ: his legal testimony or witness statement

ai.seo_question: Whose testimony is accepted in Islamic legal judgment according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal criterion for the acceptance of a person's testimony. It indicates that one born upon the fitrah and recognized for uprightness and personal righteousness is considered acceptable as a witness.
